# Electrical Engineer & Researcher

**Power Systems • Data Center Energy • Microgrids • Photovoltaics**

I am a Ph.D. Candidate in Electrical and Computer Engineering at the
University of Delaware, with research and industry experience spanning
power systems, renewable energy, data-center energy systems, load
forecasting, photovoltaics, microgrids, and data analytics.

My work focuses on understanding and designing energy systems that
integrate emerging electric loads, distributed energy resources,
renewable generation, energy storage, and data-driven methods.

## Current Focus

### Data Center Energy Systems
Load forecasting, emerging load behavior, grid impacts, and energy
infrastructure for large computing facilities.

### Microgrids & Energy Storage
Techno-economic analysis, resilience, PV+BESS systems, and grid-connected
and islanded microgrids.

### Photovoltaic Systems
Bifacial PV, performance modeling, irradiance analysis, and
data-driven power prediction.

### Power Systems
Power-system analysis, renewable integration, load modeling, and
modern grid challenges.
